name: *.txt
reason: The literal star resembles a shell wildcard.

name: ?.txt
reason: The literal question mark resembles a single-character glob.

name: [ab].txt
reason: Square brackets resemble a glob character class.

name: back\slash.txt
reason: Backslash is an ordinary filename character on Linux.

name: quote'and"quote.txt
reason: Both kinds of quotes are literal filename characters.

name: $(printf penguin).txt
reason: Looks like shell substitution, but this is only an inert text filename.

name: semi;colon.txt
reason: Semicolon is ordinary data when passed as a quoted argument.

name: report.txt
reason: ASCII space-free name; compare with report plus an invisible character.
